title: Rain Risk
description: Navigate a ship using movement instructions with direct heading and waypoint-based steering.
writeup:
## Approach

Parse instructions as `(action, value)` pairs. Both parts process the same instructions but interpret `F`, `L`, and `R` differently.

## Part 1

The ship has a position and a facing direction (initially east). `N/S/E/W` move the ship directly, `F` moves in the current facing direction, and `L/R` rotate the facing. Rotations are applied in 90-degree increments by swapping and negating the direction vector.

## Part 2

A waypoint orbits the ship (initially 10 east, 1 north, relative to the ship). `N/S/E/W` move the waypoint, `F` moves the ship toward the waypoint (multiplied by the value), and `L/R` rotate the waypoint around the ship. The answer is the Manhattan distance of the ship's final position.
